NUMERATOR PROVENANCE is exempt here (cash consideration is contractual, not derived from a capital-structure waterfall), so no re-derivation was required — the binding constraint is purely residual capture. Remaining risks are one-sided: UK court sanction, antitrust clearance and financing all have to go right just to collect 1.58%, while a break returns the stock to the low-$13s. Re-underwrite only if the spread blows out (a >8% gross gap on a still-live agreement) — otherwise there is no re-entry trigger and no reason to hold a watch seat.
